record.original_question: Is the additivity number add(S_1(Γ, Γ)) equal to b?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{N}^{\mathbb{N}}$ denote the Baire space, and define the eventual-domination quasi-order by $f \le^* g$ iff $f(n) \le g(n)$ for all but finitely many $n$. The bounding number $\mathfrak{b}$ is the least cardinality of a $\le^*$-unbounded family in $\mathbb{N}^{\mathbb{N}}$.

Let $X$ be a topological space. An open cover $\mathcal{U}$ of $X$ is a $\gamma$-cover if $\mathcal{U}$ is infinite and every $x \in X$ belongs to all but finitely many elements of $\mathcal{U}$. Let $\Gamma$ denote the collection of all open $\gamma$-covers of $X$. The space $X$ is said to satisfy the selection principle $\mathsf{S}_1(\Gamma,\Gamma)$ if for every sequence $(\mathcal{U}_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ of $\gamma$-covers of $X$ there exist $U_n \in \mathcal{U}_n$ such that $\{U_n : n\in\mathbb{N}\}$ is a $\gamma$-cover of $X$.

For a class $\mathcal{P}$ of sets of reals (viewed as a property), define the additivity number
$$\mathrm{add}(\mathcal{P}) = \min\bigl\{|\mathcal{F}| : \mathcal{F}\subseteq \mathcal{P},\ \bigcup \mathcal{F} \notin \mathcal{P}\bigr\}.$$
Let $\mathrm{add}(\mathsf{S}_1(\Gamma,\Gamma))$ be the additivity number of the family of sets of real numbers satisfying $\mathsf{S}_1(\Gamma,\Gamma)$.

Question: Is $\mathrm{add}(\mathsf{S}_1(\Gamma,\Gamma)) = \mathfrak{b}$?
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work by Bartoszyński–Shelah–Tsaban and others ("Additivity properties of topological diagonalizations" and "Additivity numbers of covering properties") studied additivity numbers of selection principles closely related to $\mathsf{S}_1(\Gamma,\Gamma)$, and some neighboring problems on the list were resolved. However, available sources do not provide a clear, definitive statement that the specific equality $\mathrm{add}(\mathsf{S}_1(\Gamma,\Gamma)) = \mathfrak{b}$ has been proved (or refuted) in ZFC; consequently the status here is recorded as unknown.

status_evidence.title: Additivity numbers of covering properties
status_evidence.snippet: An open problem posed there was solved (footnote in revision).
status_evidence.claim: Related additivity-number problems for covering properties have been addressed, though the specific status of add(S_1(Γ,Γ)) = b is not confirmed from the abstract.

status_evidence.title: Publications with B. Tsaban (Shelah archive)
status_evidence.snippet: Includes 'Critical cardinalities and additivity properties of combinatorial notions of smallness' and 'Additivity properties of topological diagonalizations'.
status_evidence.claim: Several papers study additivity of selection-principle notions, but none in the listing explicitly resolve add(S_1(Γ,Γ)) = b.
